chars.MOM: a stout Moroccan mother in her late 40s with a round expressive face, wearing a bright mustard-yellow house djellaba and a green headscarf tied at the back, holding a long wooden stick
chars.SON: a skinny Moroccan young man about 20 with a short faded haircut, wearing a red and white tracksuit jacket and black joggers
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman about 20 with a long dark ponytail, wearing a lilac hoodie and blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Seen from inside a small old stone rooftop room in a popular neighbourhood of Sale, Morocco: MOM stands in the low wooden doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, turning a big iron key in the door lock with one hand and gripping her wooden stick in the other, eyes narrowed with a furious comic glare. Morning light behind her, laundry lines in the background. Subject centred, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Inside the old stone rooftop room: MOM raises her wooden stick high, charging comically at GIRL who shields her head with her arms and squeals, a thin mattress and blanket on the floor. Slapstick, exaggerated expressions, faces visible, subjects centred, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. In the rooftop room doorway, SON in sleepy messy hair stands between MOM and the door, shouting and waving his hands at MOM in protest; MOM turns toward him, stick in hand, eyebrows raised in outrage. Faces visible, centred, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Close shot: MOM points her wooden stick right at SON's nose, mouth wide open yelling, veins on her forehead, comic fury; SON shrinks back, eyes wide. Old stone wall behind. Faces in the upper-middle of the frame, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. A narrow popular alley of Sale, Morocco seen from above: three nosy neighbour women in colourful headscarves lean out of windows and a balcony, pointing and whispering toward a rooftop room across the street, gossiping faces visible, laundry lines and satellite dishes. Subjects centred, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. On the rooftop: SON crouches covering his head with both arms while MOM swings the wooden stick at him, comic motion lines, his face grimacing; in a thought bubble-like faded background, two tough big brothers with scarred faces glare and crack their knuckles. Faces visible, centred, no text.
